title: Video clips
doc: Visual effect clips (animated bitmaps, VFX meshes and particle bursts) that weapons, clutter and events play by name.

sections.name: #Vclips
sections.doc: List of clips; each starts at $Name: and the list ends at #End.

fields.name: $Name:
fields.doc: Unique clip name that other tables refer to.

fields.name: $damage:
fields.doc: Damage per metre of radius when the clip is an explosion.

fields.name: $VBM Filename:
fields.doc: Animated bitmap shown as a sprite.

fields.name: $Explosion Name:
fields.doc: Particle explosion spawned with the clip.

fields.name: $VFX Filename:
fields.doc: Animated VFX mesh played by the clip.

fields.name: $VFX Radius:
fields.doc: Radius of the VFX used for visibility culling.

fields.name: $particle count:

children.name: $pos:
children.doc: Emitter position relative to its parent.

children.name: $dir:
children.doc: Main emission direction (normalised by the game).

children.name: $dir_rand:
children.doc: Spread around the direction; -1 emits in every direction.

children.name: $min_vel:
children.doc: Lowest starting speed of a particle.

children.name: $max_vel:
children.doc: Highest starting speed of a particle.

children.name: $spawn_radius:
children.doc: Radius of the sphere particles start in.

children.name: $min_spawn_delay:
$max_spawn_delay:
children.doc: Longest time between two particles; read only after $min_spawn_delay:.
Shortest time between two particles.

children.name: $emitter_flags:
children.doc: Emitter options; the game looks for each option name inside the quoted text, so any separator works.

children.name: $initially_on:
children.doc: Whether the emitter starts emitting.

children.name: $alternate_states:
children.when: children read only when the value is true

children.name: $on_time:
children.doc: Time spent emitting.

children.name: $on_time_variance:
children.doc: Random variation of the on time.

children.name: $off_time:
children.doc: Time spent idle.

children.name: $off_time_variance:
children.doc: Random variation of the off time.
Whether the emitter switches on and off by itself.

children.name: $min_life_secs:
children.doc: Shortest particle life.

children.name: $max_life_secs:
children.doc: Longest particle life.

children.name: $min_pradius:
children.doc: Smallest particle radius.

children.name: $max_pradius:
children.doc: Largest particle radius.

children.name: $growth_rate:
children.doc: How fast particles grow (negative shrinks).

children.name: $acceleration:
children.doc: Acceleration along the travel direction (negative slows).

children.name: $gravity_scale:
children.doc: Multiplier on gravity for particles with the gravity flag.

children.name: $bitmap:
children.doc: Particle image: a bitmap, or a .vbm animation.

children.name: $particle color:
children.doc: Starting tint {r, g, b, a}.

children.name: $particle color dest:
children.doc: Tint at the end of the life (used with clr_change).

children.name: $particle flags:
children.doc: Particle options; the game looks for each option name inside the quoted text (so collide also matches collide_liquid).

children.name: $bounciness:
children.doc: Bounce strength for colliding particles.

children.name: $stickiness:
children.doc: Chance of sticking to what a colliding particle hits.

children.name: $swirliness:
children.doc: Amount of random swirl.

children.name: $damage_factor:
children.doc: Damage dealt by particles with the damages flag.

children.name: $age_pct_to_finish_vbm:
children.doc: Fraction of the life over which a .vbm animation plays once.

fields.doc: Particles per metre of radius; when present, a full set of particle emitter fields follows.
